title: Creative Hub
pitch: Home for all creators to build and create art with ease.

live_observation.first_impression: A creator dashboard labeled Welcome back shows project search, Start New Project, Import, and a minimal project area with zoom controls. Its purpose as a creative workspace is understandable, though the initial page contains little explanatory content.
live_observation.after_state: The dashboard changed to a selectable project/canvas-style view with many clickable regions and plus/minus controls, but no clear project-creation form or named new project appeared.
live_observation.notes: The page title reports Hello from Electron renderer; visual project content and controls are sparse in the captured state.
